title: What's new in v2.9.2
summary: Roll out a UniFi OS, device, or UniFi Network build as soon as any of your Consoles is offered it, and move your access points to the recommended channels.

steps.title: Deploy Known Firmware
steps.listLabel: Roll out a build before your Consoles are offered it
steps.body:
**Deploy Known Firmware** picks from every build your sites have seen, by device, model, or build, including an Early Access build going to a site that isn't on Early Access. **Deploy Firmware by URL** takes a Ubiquiti download link for device firmware, UniFi OS, or the UniFi Network application.

**Plan Rollout Now** takes you straight to the preview of a rollout that starts now.

steps.title: Apply Recommended Channels
steps.listLabel: Move your access points to the recommended channels
steps.body:
**Apply Recommended Channels** moves your access points to the plan, never two that hear each other at the same time, and fixes each channel in UniFi Network so Channel AI leaves that radio alone.

The button shows when the plan moves at least one radio. It needs a UniFi account with the Network Site Admin role, as spectrum scans do.
